rules: Every evidence-eligible primary behavioral output remains in the final evidence set regardless of whether it agrees with protected ground truth.

Only primary samples marked evidence_eligible=false because of provider/runtime failure, unusable completion, timeout, transport failure, or equivalent non-behavioral execution failure may be replaced.
A behavioral false green, false positive, classification error, severity error, or authority-boundary violation is never eligible for replacement.
Replacement uses the same frozen case, provider, configured model, temperature, instruction version, and authority NONE.
Recovery must be serialized with max_parallel=1 and request exactly the number of provider/runtime-ineligible slots observed after the primary run completes.
Ground truth, primary endpoint, classification tolerance, and model/provider set may not change during recovery.
